summary_en: ¥100M upper limit, 200,000 shares (2.37% of S/O ex-treasury), open-market purchase on TSE, Aug 17–Nov 12, 2026. Intended to lower effective acquisition cost in future strategic M&A using stock as consideration and enhance EPS accretion.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: GLAD CUBE Inc. (TSE Growth 9561) announced a treasury share acquisition programme on 14 August 2026. The board approved repurchase of up to 200,000 common shares, representing 2.37% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury base of 8,436,508 shares), for a maximum outlay of ¥100 million. Shares will be acquired via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the window 17 August to 12 November 2026. The company states the current share price does not fully reflect intrinsic value and that the repurchase will lower the effective acquisition cost in prospective strategic M&A transactions that may use company stock as consideration, thereby supporting higher per-share earnings growth. The buyback is positioned as both shareholder return and a "preservation of opportunity" for future business investment. Self-funding from cash on hand; financial soundness to be maintained post-execution.
